content:
Maria V: quick design question — in trace viewer, stacking long stack traces pushes call details off-screen on mobile. propose collapsing library frames by default and showing 'Show context' inline. Thoughts?
Sam K: +1 for collapsing libs. can we use heuristics (node_modules, /usr/lib) to auto-group? also need an affordance for copy-all.
Ashley R: a11y note: collapsed regions need `aria-expanded` and a keyboard toggle. also ensure focus is moved to first frame when expanded.
Leo Chen: export action: current CSV includes 'trace_id,duration' — customer asked for correlation_id too. Suggest label 'Correlation ID' not 'Corr ID'
Maria V: agreed on label. UX nit: the export button reads 'Download' — prefer 'Export trace' to be explicit. small copy tweak.
Sam K: re keyboard: add `e` shortcut? maybe ctrl+e conflicts. what about `x`? :thinking_face: 
Ashley R: don't invent single-letter shortcuts globally. we have a pattern: `g` for global nav, `f` for find. maybe `t` for trace actions. will check standards.
TraceBot: deploy-preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/trace/viewer/1766123456 — accessible to design/eng
Maria V: mock attached (link) — shows collapsed frames with count chip and 'Show 12 hidden frames' CTA.
Leo Chen: sample export format I'm proposing:
```
trace_id,correlation_id,timestamp_ms,duration_ms,error,message,service
abc123,cor-789,1680000000000,120,TypeError,'x is undefined',payment
```
Ashley R: accessibility nit: in the drilldown, stack frames need more color contrast (current #6b6 vs recommended). Also tooltips need `aria-label` values.
Sam K: engineering concern: grouping by path will need regexes per runtime; prefer maintanable list plus opt-out toggle in settings.
Maria V: decision: I'll update the mock to use 'Export trace' button, collapsed lib frames with count chip, add aria-expanded and keyboard focus behaviors. @Sam K can you scope the regex list effort? @Leo Chen can you update export to include correlation_id and that CSV row format?
Sam K: yep I can take regex list and a settings toggle. estimate 2w.
Leo Chen: I'll add correlation_id and wire up export endpoints. quick Q: include span-level metadata? maybe later.
Ashley R: once updated I'd like to run a508/a11y test and keyboard walkthrough. ping me when ready.
Maria V: ok thanks all — will push updated figma and add acceptance criteria in the ticket. :thumbsup:
